properties.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued October 13 at 7:56AM CDT until October 13 at 10:00AM CDT by NWS Mobile AL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Dense fog will reduce visibility to 1 NM or less.

* WHERE...Mississippi Sound.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM CDT this morning.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility will make navigation difficult.
properties.instruction:
If you must navigate, proceed with caution. Use proper fog
signals. Make sure all running lights are on. Remember to use
your radar and compass.

properties.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued October 13 at 6:55AM MDT until October 13 at 12:00PM MDT by NWS Great Falls MT
properties.description:
* WHAT...Highly variable visibility as low as one quarter of a mile
in dense fog.

* WHERE...Portions of central, north central, and southwest Montana.

* WHEN...Until noon MDT today.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Below freezing temperatures may lead to a
glaze of ice on surfaces, most notably on bridges and overpasses.
properties.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.

NWSheadline: DENSE FOG ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL NOON MDT TODAY

properties.areaDesc: Del Norte Vicinity/Northern San Luis Valley Below 8500 Ft; Alamosa  Vicinity/Central San Luis Valley Below 8500 Ft; Southern San Luis Valley
properties.headline: Freeze Watch issued October 13 at 6:46AM MDT until October 15 at 8:00AM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures as low as 27 possible.

* WHERE...The San Luis Valley.

* WHEN...From late Wednesday night through Thursday morning.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...A killing freeze will be possible which could
bring an end to the growing season across the San Luis Valley.
properties.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.

properties.areaDesc: Icy Cape to Cape Suckling out to 15 NM
properties.headline: Gale Warning issued October 13 at 4:15AM AKDT until October 15 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the first Small Craft Advisory, east winds 15 to 25
kt expected. For the second Small Craft Advisory, east winds
20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and seas 6 to 9 ft
expected. For the first Gale Warning, east winds 25 to 35 kt
with gusts up to 50 kt and seas 9 to 14 ft expected. For the
third Small Craft Advisory, east winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts
up to 45 kt and seas 13 to 18 ft expected. For the second Gale
Warning, east winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and
seas 14 to 19 ft expected. For the additional Small Craft
Advisory, southeast winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 40 kt
and seas 12 to 17 ft expected.

* WHERE...Icy Cape to Cape Suckling out to 15 NM.

* WHEN...For the first Small Craft Advisory, from 10 AM this
morning to 6 PM AKDT this evening. For the second Small Craft
Advisory, from 4 PM to 10 PM AKDT Wednesday. For the first
Gale Warning, from 10 PM Wednesday to 4 AM AKDT Thursday. For
the third Small Craft Advisory, from 4 AM to 10 AM AKDT
Thursday. For the second Gale Warning, from 10 AM to 4 PM AKDT
Thursday. For the additional Small Craft Advisory, from 4 PM
Thursday to 4 AM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
properties.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
